searchTerm.title: Search term
searchTerm.description: Free-text search across company name, product, and complaint narrative (e.g. "Wells Fargo", "overdraft fee", "student loan servicer"). Leave blank to skip keyword filtering.

product.title: Product
product.description: Limit to a specific financial product category.
enum: Credit reporting or other personal consumer reports
Money transfer, virtual currency, or money service
Payday loan, title loan, personal loan, or advance loan

state.title: State
state.description: Two-letter US state code to limit to complaints from consumers there (e.g. "CA"). Leave blank for all states.

daysBack.title: Days back
daysBack.description: How many days back from today to search, based on the date CFPB received the complaint.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of complaints to return, most recently received first.
